_note: F6: hand-built Arizona answer key, independent of the lead-finder tool. Every building here was found from news, press releases, developer sites, or an apartment's own website -- never from a city permit layer or the county sales file (those are what the tool itself reads, and checking against them would not test anything). Each entry lists its source link and source type so any entry can be re-verified by hand. 5 entries also carry a hand-verified `software` field, read directly off the building's own resident-portal/apply-now links (not guessed, not taken from a listing site).
